articles.author: FingerMotion, Inc.
articles.headline: FingerMotion Sets Out New Management's Strategic Plan with BlueFlare Energy Solutions for AI Focused Modular Data Center Expansion
sourceWarnings: Plan estratégico anunciado; la fuente aclara que no se habían anunciado contratos definitivos de proyectos, clientes ni financiación de los centros.
articles.summary: FingerMotion outlined a proposed North American modular AI data-center strategy with BlueFlare and its previously closed 9.9% Lyken investment. The release expressly did not announce a new site, customer offtake or project financing.
